고린도후서 2:1.content: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

고린도후서 2:2.content: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

고린도후서 2:3.content: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

고린도후서 2:4.content: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

고린도후서 2:5.content: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

고린도후서 2:6.content: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

고린도후서 2:7.content: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

고린도후서 2:8.content: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

고린도후서 2:9.content: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

고린도후서 2:10.content: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

고린도후서 2:11.content: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

고린도후서 2:12.content: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

고린도후서 2:13.content: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

고린도후서 2:14.content: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

고린도후서 2:15.content: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

고린도후서 2:16.content: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

고린도후서 2:17.content: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
